body.title: Annual Compliance Review FY2026 — 62 Controls Tested, 55 Effective, 6 Partially Effective, 1 Ineffective
body.description: Controls assessed: Employee lifecycle, access, change management, backup/DR, vendor controls, data privacy, incident response, finance approvals. One medium finding: vendor risk review expired for one vendor. Carried forward for Year 2.
